analytic_adaptations: B1 uses the actual C4 selector/Taylor-operator proof to combine the signed Hessian coefficients and derive the exact displayed kernels. The printed signed-density mass/first-moment and triangular integration intermediates are algebraically replaced, and are not claimed as literal headline dependencies.

B1 is stated for a general actual covariance factor; taking the whitened family and identity factor gives the source version. Its Gaussian and Bernoulli laws and both independent copies are explicit product/mix laws.
B2 is expressed in rectangle face coordinates pulled back through an arbitrary rectangular unit-row factor. No full rank or covariance inverse is required.
The source uses kappa>=1; the formal B2 theorem proves the more general kappa>0 case. C0 is fixed before all dimensions and probability models.
